message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc sells technology solutions that enable engineering teams to accelerate innovation across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company serves customers who rely on its mission-critical design enablement partner capabilities to bridge virtual design and physical reality for complex engineering challenges [D1]. Revenue from the Communications Solutions Group was $1.345 billion in the third quarter of 2026 while revenue from the Electronic Industrial Solutions Group was $501 million during the same period [D1].
